Build Overview

This build has it all but is GIGA pricy on the high end (ONLY BECAUSE OF OVER CORRUPTIONS OF STATS, without corrupts far under 2000 div): Speed - Multi screen aoe clear & insane single target!
Easily the fastest and best clear ive ever played in PoE 2 so far, no joke.
Cheaper version is being worked on.

All you do is zoom around as a demon mommy literally just dodging around and watch everything die.
This easily handles all content, including juiced 200% Deli.

For juiced expedition you just need a 2nd helmet with 
Raven-Touched Shard
 so you can anoint 
Crystallised Immunities
 to deal with the freeze reflecting mobs.

The way it works is simple, you use 
Earthbound
 to snapshot "trigger spark skill on killing a shocked enemy" combined with the 
Adonia's Ego
 buff " 
Pinnacle of Power
" for absolute screen wide destruction.

Attribute requirements:

Strength: 67
Dexterity: 92
Intelligence: 157

Rotation once you enter map: 
1. weapon swap to 
Earthbound

2.  
Powered by Verisium
 
3.  
Ball Lightning
 
4. teleport on 
Ball Lightning
 with 
Lightning Warp
 (because of 
Elemental Equilibrium
 the lightning warp gives us cold infusions instead of lightning ones)
5. spam 
Spark
 up to whatever max power charges you can get
6. 
Powered by Verisium
 again (optional)
7. 
Rite of Restoration
 (force this to swap you back to weapon set 1 with 
Adonia's Ego
)
8. 
Pinnacle of Power
 (If you forget to press this you will die)
9. use 
Demon Form
 you can now zoom around, the buff either lasts 2min and sometimes 4min - if the time runs out start at 1. again (4 minutes buff also means 4x damage).

Optionally you can also use 
Ball Lightning
 from time to time and use 
Lightning Warp
 on them to get more damage buffs but personally I never do this because everything dies with the above steps already.

Whenever needed you can also use the self cast 
Spark
 which should delete whatever gets close to you.

For bosses, single target:
1. 
Powered by Verisium

2. use a few 
Ball Lightning
's
This creates fire on the floor which will trigger tons of 
Cast on Elemental Ailment
 which triggers infinite 
Comet
's instantly deleting ANY boss (even in 6 man groups)!
Carpet of 
Comet
's!

For survivability we use:

Everything dies before it can touch us is one of the main defensives, you  speed dodge around only!


Reverie
 for BONKERS life regen, currently I have 1899 life per second.

Ultimate Life Flask
 23% quality, 100% increased life recovered & removes 15% of life recovered from mana when used.


Mageblood
 with "Legacy of Ruby" and maybe even "Legacy of Topaz/Bishmuth" is a must have in order to have enough max fire resist to survive the self damage from 
Pyromantic Pact
. Ideally your mageblood should have double quicksilver + ruby + Topaz/Bismuth and if possible get close to 50% increased effect.



Explosive Transmutation
 combined with 
Mórrigan's Insight
 lineage support procs off our 
Infusion
from runic exctaction, which consumes freeze and gives us 2845 guard.


Decree of Flight
 helps you dodge faster meaning your gameplay speeds up and you deal damage faster, this should absolutely be a minimum of 30% faster dodge roll.
For the fastest dodge rolls you want to aim for 92% movement speed but this breakpoint is quite hard to achieve and barely noticeable. 72% total movementspeed should be minimal.

Your gloves will be a pair of rare gloves, you want to have projectile speed, life and fork for the split - the others can be replaced for res or others stuff to settle (this will help out a lot because there isnt much room for resists.)


Alpha's Howl
 (runemastered) is because this build gets a ton of damage from spirit stacking, the more spirit the better - You must get one with +1 power charges (additional spirit as a double corrupt is a bonus).



Threaded Light
